prompts.orbit: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: transparent 3D astronomical decoration atlas for dark mobile app store screenshots NEBO. Create three distinct large premium realistic sculptural celestial objects, all completely separate with generous empty transparent padding, arranged in one horizontal row, landscape 3:1 canvas. Left: a warm amber Saturn-like ringed planet viewed at a dramatic oblique angle, crisp golden rings, physically believable banded surface, softly lit from top left. Middle: a luminous petrol-blue and turquoise sphere planet with fine cloud-like marbling, no obvious continents, rim-lit cyan and white. Right: a pale silver moon with subtle real crater texture, warm side lighting. Each object occupies its own equal third, nothing touches another, no object cropped. Polished editorial space photography meets refined 3D product render, believable texture, subtle depth. Entire backdrop genuinely transparent, no rectangle, no built-in space scene or stars, no text, letters, labels, logo, diagrams, mystical props or human figures. These will be composed with real app screenshots and huge Russian typography in a navy and teal campaign. Keep objects bright enough to read on dark navy but no excessive glow haze. All three full silhouettes including rings intact.
prompts.people: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: original editorial lifestyle photo for a light NEBO astrology app store campaign. A candid warm realistic photograph of two adult friends or partners, woman around 28 with shoulder-length brown hair in a coral red cardigan over ivory top, man around 30 with short dark hair in navy overshirt, sitting close together at a simple outdoor café bench in bright soft morning light. The woman holds a plain coral smartphone vertically with its BACK visible at chest height and both look at it with quiet spontaneous amused smiles. Faces believable, real skin and normal proportions, contemporary everyday Russian/European city feeling, relaxed elegant casual clothes. Composition: wide landscape photograph, upper bodies to lap fully visible, people grouped mainly in the center and right half; left third softly blurred pale cream background with a tiny hint of greenery, enough negative space. Color: warm ivory, peach, muted sage, coral and navy, natural daylight, understated film photography, no fashion glamour. No visible writing, text, logos, signage, app UI, extra fingers, mystical objects, planets, astrology symbols, crystals, exaggerated happiness, jewelry branding. This is a new original non-famous adult couple, no need to match an existing person. 3:2 landscape.
prompts.objects: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: transparent decorative 3D everyday object atlas for a bright white and ice-blue NEBO mobile app store campaign. Make four large separate objects in a 2 by 2 grid, square canvas, each entirely in its own quadrant with very generous empty transparent gutters and padding. Top left: elegant pale ice-blue rounded alarm clock, white dial, two plain dark-blue hands and minimal small tick marks, NO numbers or letters. Top right: sculptural over-ear headphones in warm ivory with cobalt blue cushions, realistically rounded and matte, not any brand. Bottom left: two smooth ceramic hearts in coral red and icy blue leaning lightly together as one joined object. Bottom right: a single graceful sculptural curl like a calm blue sea wave, glossy yet soft translucent blue glass. Style: premium tactile contemporary 3D product photography, restrained cheerful palette white cream sky blue coral, warm studio lighting from top left, physically believable materials, soft highlights, subtle object contact shadows only. Real transparent backdrop everywhere, no cards under objects, no text, letters, logo, human beings, celestial planets, moons, stars, crystals or mystical motifs. All four full silhouettes intact, all separated and fully within frame, no cropping.
